query:
SELECT 'claims_no_tenant' as metric, COUNT(*) as count FROM claims WHERE tenant_id IS NULL OR tenant_id = ''
UNION ALL
SELECT 'claims_no_claim_number', COUNT(*) FROM claims WHERE claim_number IS NULL OR claim_number = ''
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orphan_approvals', COUNT(*) FROM claim_approvals WHERE claim_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM claims)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orphan_assessments', COUNT(*) FROM ai_assessments WHERE claim_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM claims)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orphan_documents', COUNT(*) FROM claim_documents WHERE claim_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM claims)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'claims_no_assessment', COUNT(*) FROM claims c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_assessments a WHERE a.claim_id = c.id) AND c.status NOT IN ('submitted','assessment_pending')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'duplicate_assessments', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT claim_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ai_assessments GROUP BY claim_id HAVING cnt > 1) t
UNION ALL
SELECT 'total_claims', COUNT(*) FROM claims
UNION ALL
SELECT 'total_assessments', COUNT(*) FROM ai_assessments
UNION ALL
SELECT 'total_tenants', COUNT(*) FROM insurer_tenants;
